roadNote: Distances are straight lines (haversine) times 1.3 for streets. No route planner, no paid API.

walk.note: Free. Minutes at 5 km/h on the street distance.

taxi.source: Transport Department, Taxi fare of Hong Kong, urban (red) taxi, effective 14 July 2024
taxi.note: Official urban taxi meter table on the street distance. Waiting time, tunnels, baggage and booking charges are not included.

mtr.source: MTR Corporation open data, fares between every pair of stations (mtr_lines_fares.csv, file dated 2 April 2026)
mtr.note: Octopus fares. Up to 5 km: the 10th percentile of all station pairs (for example Kowloon Tong to Mong Kok, HK$3.20 student, HK$5.90 adult); up to 10 km: the 25th percentile; longer: the median. Airport and border stations left out. The real fare depends on the two stations; bus fares are not checked.
